asks: Is there anything on my back? There is usually something on my back.
Do you intend to sit down, or is this a passing-through?
What is that noise? It has been going since before you arrived.
description: A black bull has folded its legs under itself right there, back flat and broad as a table top, and is chewing at nothing with its eyes half shut.
emotes: {it} snorts, and a cloud of dust lifts off the floorboards in front of it.
{it} works its jaw sideways, slowly, staring at the middle distance.
{it} swings its head round to look at you with one enormous wet eye, then loses interest.
{it} shifts, and the whole floor takes the weight and gives it back.
looks: The back is a flat plane of muscle you could genuinely eat off. Flies are not landing on it; they are keeping a respectful distance.
One horn is broken off short. The stump has been rubbed smooth against something, over years.
Its jaw works sideways, unhurried, grinding a mouthful of something it did not get in this room.
name: a bull lying down
says: Put it down on me if you like. I will not move quickly.
The floor is cold. I have been improving it.
I stood up once today. It was enough.
